approach: In history.rs add LandingKind (snake_case enum: JobLanding, DeclaredIntervention, RecordsOnly); LandingCommit gets a required `kind` and Option job/verification (serde default, skip_serializing_if none), deny_unknown_fields kept. Landing::validate enforces per kind with two new HistoryError variants. gh.rs commits() sets JobLanding with Some job/verification; intent() handles Option job; test constructor ~3788 updated. History tests updated. CHANGELOG entry added. manage.rs untouched unless the compiler requires it. land.rs untouched.

decisions.choice: job and verification become Option with default + skip_serializing_if; kind has no default so a missing kind is a parse error.
decisions.reason: Non-job kinds must not claim a job; JSON stays clean; kind is required as requested.

rejected.why: Changes the JSON shape away from the requested flat kind field.

decisions.choice: Forbid both job and verification for non-job kinds.
decisions.reason: Matches the accepted reading of 'must not claim a job'.

rejected.why: A verification without a job is meaningless for these kinds.

decisions.choice: New HistoryError variants MissingForKind and NotAllowedForKind.

rejected.why: Its message misleads for forbidden fields.

commits() sets JobLanding with Some job/verification; intent() handles Option; update test constructor.

steps: Add LandingKind in history.rs (Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize; rename_all snake_case) with docs.
Change LandingCommit: add kind; job/verification Option with serde default and skip_serializing_if; keep deny_unknown_fields.
Add two HistoryError variants and per-kind checks in the Landing::validate loop.
Update landing() helper and add tests: each kind round-trips, unknown kind, missing kind, unknown field, job_landing without job/verification, non-job kinds with job/verification, omitted keys.
gh.rs commits(): set kind JobLanding, Some(job), Some(verification); compute verification before moving c.job.
gh.rs intent(): collect job_ids only from commits with Some job.
Run cargo test -p athena-data, cargo test -p athena-core gh, cargo clippy -p athena-data -p athena-core, cargo fmt --check.

demonstrations.method: Unit test serializes each kind's commit and checks JSON; diff inspection for deny_unknown_fields and three variants.
demonstrations.observes: kind serializes as job_landing/declared_intervention/records_only; non-job commits have no job/verification keys; git diff shows deny_unknown_fields retained.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without Option+skip_serializing_if the key-absence assertions fail; without snake_case rename the kind string assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests mutate landing() commits per kind and call Landing::validate.
demonstrations.observes: job_landing missing job or verification -> Err; declared_intervention/records_only with job or verification -> Err; valid combos -> Ok.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without per-kind checks in Landing::validate the Err assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Round-trip each kind via HistoryRecord::parse(to_pretty_json); mutate JSON for unknown kind, removed kind, extra field.
demonstrations.observes: Each kind round-trips equal; the three malformed inputs return Err(Parse).
demonstrations.fails_without: Without a required closed enum, a missing or unknown kind would parse and the Err assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Run gh tests; the landing test compares commits() output with an expected LandingCommit of kind JobLanding with job and verification; git diff shows land.rs unchanged.
demonstrations.observes: Landing test passes; land.rs absent from the diff.
demonstrations.fails_without: If commits() did not set JobLanding/job/verification the equality assertion at ~3787 fails (and the crate would not compile with the new required field).

demonstrations.method: Run clippy on both crates, then format check; any warning or unformatted code fails the commands.
demonstrations.fails_without: Unhandled Option job in intent(), unused variants/imports, or unformatted code would make clippy warn or fmt --check exit nonzero.
